newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called steady with firm cash.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called steady with firm cash.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open little changed Friday after a quiet ACCESS session and early talk of steady cash prices, industry sources said.
September over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.175 to $2.185 after settling Thursday at $2.177 per million British thermal units.
On ACCESS, September traded in a tight range, ending unchanged at $2.177.
Cash prices at Henry Hub were talked at $2.22-2.24 as a brief spell of warmer weather moved across most of the U.S. However, cooler weather is expected to return by early next week.
Technical traders said September support was at $2.15-2.16 and then at $2.10, $2.08 and $2.045. Resistance was seen at $2.19-2.20 and then at $2.27.
In Thursday's cash, Gulf Coast gas firmed a few cents to about $2.20. August Midcon gained almost five cents to $2.12-2.15. New York city gate gas held relatively steady in the low-$2.40s.
